en.headline: Police arrest three teens over alleged assault on 13-year-old at Lingnan Secondary
en.dek: Eastern District officers detained three boys aged 13 to 15 on Friday after a report that a classmate was attacked on the school basketball court in Heng Fa Chuen.
body: Police arrested three teenage boys on suspicion of common assault after a 13-year-old student was allegedly attacked by classmates at Lingnan Secondary School in Heng Fa Chuen.

Officers said they received a report on Wednesday that the boy had been assaulted on campus the previous day. Following investigation, the case was classified as common assault. The boy sustained no superficial injuries and was sent to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital for medical examination as a precaution.

The three suspects, aged between 13 and 15, were arrested in the Eastern district and Sham Shui Po on Friday. They have been released on bail and must report back to police in mid-December, according to police.

Accounts of the incident indicated that several pupils in the same year surrounded and mocked the boy while he was eating lunch on the school's ground-floor basketball court, with some allegedly punching him, kicking his lower body and throwing a basketball. The boy is understood to have disabilities including hearing impairment. The school confirmed there had been a conflict between students and said it was cooperating with the investigation while providing guidance and counselling support.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕三名少年 涉嫌在嶺南中學普通襲擊13歲同窗
zh.dek: 東區警區人員周五在東區及深水埗拘捕三名13至15歲男生，事緣一名同窗在杏花邨學校籃球場被指遭受襲擊。
body: 警方拘捕三名青少年，涉嫌普通襲擊一名在杏花邨嶺南中學就讀的13歲男學生。
警方表示，周三接獲報案，指該名男童前日在校內被襲擊。初步調查後，案件列為普通襲擊。男童無表面傷痕，已送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院檢查。
三名年齡介乎13至15歲的嫌疑人於周五在東區及深水埗被捕。他們已獲准保釋，須於12月中旬向警方報到。
據了解，事發時男童在學校地下籃球場用膳，被數名同級同學包圍嘲弄，有人揮拳及踢向下半身，亦有人投擲籃球。男童據悉有聽力障礙等情況。校方確認學生之間有衝突，並表示會全力配合調查，同時透過輔導及社工提供支援。
